use crate::collections::shapes::interface::ShapesItem;

#[test]
fn refuses_a_negative_area() {
    struct Negative;
    impl ShapesItem for Negative {
        fn area(&self) -> f64 {
            -1.0
        }
    }
    assert!(crate::collections::shapes::interface_test::check(&Negative).is_err());
}
